name: Soft haze
one_line: Calm and airy: a faint glow, soft sun shafts, gentle contrast. Never glares.

glow.help: The halo round bright things. Keep it low: this look is restrained on purpose.
glow.label: Glow

glowFrom.help: How bright something must be before it glows. Lower = more of the picture glows.
glowFrom.label: Glow from

shafts.help: Soft rays when the sun is in or near the frame.
shafts.label: Sun shafts

softness.help: Lower contrast and lifted shadows. 0 = crisp.
softness.label: Softness

measured.how: hidden Chromium on the kit's test laptop, whole frame read back from the graphics chip; machine load changes it
